What we learned: running the solve section inside lax.map changes the reverse-pass rounding regardless of chunk size, and the large reverse-pass savings come from exactly that. Running assembly per frequency is strict-safe and saves about 2.2 s of forward execution, but costs about 0.3 s more gradient execution and about 0.8 s more compile. About 28 minutes remain. After candidate 8's result I'll record it and stop.
